entry.title: Shipping
entry.summary: Behaviour specifications for Shipping, generated from Gherkin feature files.
entry.content:
Behaviour specifications generated from the repository’s Gherkin feature files.

  • Book a consignment — A booking reserves space on one sailing for one consignment.
  • Declare a consignment to customs — Every consignment that crosses a customs border needs a declaration lodged before the sailing’s cut-off.
